title: My First Mealtime Routine: Wash, Eat, Tidy Up
description:
#vocavoca #kidssongs #babysongs 
🍝🧼 Wash hands, eat neatly, tidy up! A gentle mealtime routine for little ones. A story about good habits, hygiene, and helping at home. Perfect for co-viewing (ages 2–5).

👋 Hello, little friend!

Do you like spaghetti? Yummy! But wait — what should we do before we eat? 🍝

Yes! We wash our hands with soap and water. Scrub, scrub, scrub! Now they're clean and ready for food.

Then we sit at the table and eat. But we don't play with our food or make a big mess — we eat neatly, like a big kid! 😊

And when we finish? We don't just run away. We tidy up our plate and wash it. Splash, splash! Now the table is clean and ready for next time.

title: Baby Need to Go Potty | Potty Training Song | Big and Small | Kids Songs #shorts
description:
Max needs to go potty, but which potty is the right size for him? 🚽 
He explores different toilets and potties from big to small, learning that different sizes are made for different needs. Finally, Max finds the perfect little potty and happily uses it all by himself!

✨ Lesson: Learning about big and small can be part of potty training, and choosing an age-appropriate potty helps children build confidence and healthy bathroom habits.

💡 Parent Tips
1. Choose a stable, child-sized potty or toilet seat that helps your child feel safe and comfortable.
2. Practice the concepts of big and small using everyday objects to make early learning fun.
